description: Shared Go↔TypeScript V2/V3 receipt evidence_sha256 contract corpus. Both runtimes must accept or reject each case identically. V2 = legacy (no evidence binding). V3 = evidence binding mandatory.

fixtures.name: v2-no-evidence-pass
fixtures.description: V2 receipt with no evidence_sha256 is valid legacy

fixtures.name: v2-evidence-present-fail
fixtures.description: V2 receipt carrying evidence_sha256 is INVALID
fixtures.error_contains: v2 terminal receipt must not contain evidence_sha256

fixtures.name: v2-malformed-evidence-fail
fixtures.description: V2 receipt carrying malformed evidence_sha256 is INVALID
fixtures.error_contains: v2 terminal receipt must not contain evidence_sha256

fixtures.name: v3-no-evidence-fail
fixtures.description: V3 receipt with no evidence_sha256 is INVALID
fixtures.error_contains: v3 terminal receipt must bind evidence_sha256

fixtures.name: v3-malformed-evidence-fail
fixtures.description: V3 receipt with malformed evidence_sha256 is INVALID

fixtures.name: v3-valid-evidence-pass
fixtures.description: V3 receipt with valid 64-char lowercase hex evidence_sha256 is valid

fixtures.name: v3-empty-string-evidence-fail
fixtures.description: V3 receipt with empty-string evidence_sha256 is INVALID
fixtures.error_contains: v3 terminal receipt must bind evidence_sha256

fixtures.name: v3-uppercase-evidence-fail
fixtures.description: V3 receipt with uppercase hex evidence_sha256 is INVALID (must be lowercase)

fixtures.name: v3-short-evidence-fail
fixtures.description: V3 receipt with 63-char evidence_sha256 is INVALID (must be 64)
